solution_text: H2 has two electrons occupying the bonding molecular orbital. Bond order = (bonding electrons - antibonding electrons)/2 = (2-0)/2 = 1.
tips: Use bond order = (Nb - Na)/2 for a molecular-orbital configuration.

solution_text: At constant temperature and pressure, a process is spontaneous when delta G is less than zero. At equilibrium, delta G is zero.
tips: Remember the spontaneity criterion: delta G < 0 at constant temperature and pressure.
